comments.what: Committed performance budgets, enforced by scripts/check-bundle-budgets.mjs on every build (CI: after the asset gate). All JS/HTML numbers are gzip KiB measured from dist/ — fully deterministic, identical on a laptop and on software-rendered CI. 'hard' fails the build; 'target' prints a warning (drift guard).
comments.heroGraph: The dynamically-imported engine graph: three-core + three-post + the createScene scene-code chunk + the warmThree facade. Measured 232.4 KiB gz on 2026-07-10 (three-core 124.0 + createScene 103.5 + three-post 4.8 + warmThree 0.1). The roadmap's 210 KiB aspiration is NOT met: the excess is the site's own scene code (createScene 295 KiB raw — 9 shaders, GPGPU sim, cockpit geometry), and trimming it means an engine diet, not a P10 cheap win. Target is set at current+headroom so growth warns immediately; hard stays at the roadmap's 240 cap.
comments.preHeroRoute: JS actually requested by an ENGINE page (/, /behind-the-build, /graveyard) before the engine import fires: eager <script> tags + astro-island component/renderer URLs + their static import closure. Dynamic imports (the engine graph) are excluded by construction. Measured 93.6 KiB gz on / (2026-07-10). The roadmap's 85/65 caps predate counting the React island runtime as pre-hero JS: react-dom/client alone is 56.0 KiB gz, and the interactive-before-engine surface (HeroIsland shell, HUD nav, loader/skip controls) is React — removing it is a shell rewrite, not a P10 trim. Everything else on the route totals ~38 KiB. Hard/target adjusted to reality and documented here instead of silently reclassifying the runtime.
comments.readingRoute: Same eager-JS measurement for non-engine routes (about, projects, writing, contact, posts, 404). Measured max 15.6 KiB gz (2026-07-10). TIGHTENED far below the roadmap's 85/65: at those caps a React-runtime leak onto a reading route (+56 KiB) would pass silently — at 40/20 it fails the build, which is the regression this budget exists to catch (P4's zero-three.js e2e guards the engine chunks; this guards everything else).
comments.html: Per-page HTML gzip. Stylesheets are inlined (inlineStylesheets:'always'), so this single number also caps CSS growth including the P9 grain/backdrop data-URIs (the P9→P10 handoff note). Measured max 50.5 KiB gz (/behind-the-build, 2026-07-10); target = reality + headroom, hard = comfortable ceiling under the roadmap's 120.
comments.rasters: Echo of the raster gate enforced by scripts/check-asset-sizes.mjs (hard fail >500 KiB, warn >250 KiB). Kept here so budgets.json is the one place all shipping budgets live.
